name: Kalooki (Caribbean)
description: Kalooki (specifically the Caribbean or Jamaican version) is a high-stakes, 108-card contract rummy game. Played over nine rounds with increasing difficulty, it requires players to complete specific 'contracts' of sets (threes) and runs (fours). It is a central part of Caribbean social life and is known for the 'Call' mechanic where players can snatch discards out of turn.

content.text: Kalooki (specifically the Caribbean or Jamaican version) is a high-stakes, 108-card contract rummy game. Played over nine rounds with increasing difficulty, it requires players to complete specific 'contracts' of sets (threes) and runs (fours). It is a central part of Caribbean social life and is known for the 'Call' mechanic where players can snatch discards out of turn.
Derived from European Rummy games (like Kalooki 40), it was heavily adapted in Jamaica to include the 'out-of-turn call' and specific contract escalations.
Two standard decks and four Jokers (Total 108 cards).
108 cards, score sheet, chips for stakes (optional)
Varies by round: Hand 1 (9 cards), Hand 2 (10), ... Hand 9 (16 cards).

items.text: Super Kalooki: High-stakes version played starting from Hand 5.
European Kalooki: Different contract requirements and Joker rules.
